properties.description: At every design epoch, computes each named projection's independent cycles and matches them to the previous epoch's (persistent homology over the epoch sequence; zigzag where relationships end), so a cycle reports when it formed, when it broke or was filled in, and how long it has stood; epochs where many form or break at once are reported as readings.
properties.name: Each named projection's cycles carry the design epoch they formed and the epoch they broke or were filled in
